readme_summary: Sei is the fastest general purpose L1 blockchain and the first parallelized EVM. This allows Sei to get the best of Solana and Ethereum - a hyper optimized execution layer that benefits from the tooling and mindshare around the EVM. Developer reference in this repo: EVM JSON-RPC explicitly unsupported methods (methods that return `-32000` with a clear message). Starting with v6.7, IBC module source and wiring are removed. IBC queries, historical transfer transaction decoding, and pre-v6.7 IBC precompile tracing are not served by v6.7 nodes. Run a v6.6 freeze node to serve pre-v6.7 IBC history. The IBC precompile at `0x1009` remains registered only as a tombstone that reverts every call. Starting with v6.8, the `ibc`, `transfer` and `capability` stores are deleted from state, and the four passed `ClientUpdateProposal` records (proposals 52, 81, 100 and 119) are rewritten as `TextProposal`
